produce.prompt_used:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent paper-material backing for Donate7 donor name and amount; runtime text will be placed separately.
Reference image role: the attached overlay comp is MATERIAL AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY. Use the light warm peach paper beneath the donor name/amount as material reference; do not reproduce or crop any region of the comp.
Primary request: generate ONE completely blank, wide horizontal strip of warm peach handmade cut paper, with irregular naturally torn/deckled edges on all four sides and a very subtle tactile paper fiber grain. A fresh standalone asset, orthographic front view.
Composition: approximately 1024x320 canvas, 3.2:1 landscape aspect ratio. Paper fills about 94% of canvas width and 84% of height, centered, leaving genuinely transparent margins around every edge. Mostly straight long edges with small irregular tears and fibers, asymmetric short torn sides; corners naturally rough, not rounded UI corners. Wide calm middle for high contrast donor text. Single paper layer only, no folds or curled perspective.
Color palette: warm pale peach #FFD3B8 / #FFDCC3 with faint slightly warmer peach fibers, matching the comp donor backing. Even subdued surface color; no pink painted border.
Lighting/material: matte papery finish, delicate fine visible fibers and flecks, no polished surface; little internal lighting variation. No drop shadow outside the paper, no external glow, no thickness/extrusion.
Constraints: output real RGBA alpha with fully transparent surrounding pixels. Absolutely blank paper: NO letters, NO numbers, NO typography, NO symbols, NO icons, NO hearts, NO rabbits, NO human faces, NO banknotes, NO scribbles, NO border, NO watermark. No gameplay or scene. Do not paint checkerboard background; transparency is actual alpha.

produce.qa_evidence: Visual comparison passes blank warm peach, fine fibers, deckled silhouette and transparent cutout role; no letters, icons, figures or painted external shadow. Pillow read-only inspection confirms RGBA alpha0-255.
produce.implementation: Place decorative img with alt="" behind the live donor name/amount. CSS owns size, rotation, stacking, and any shadow; do not rasterize donor data. Preserve readable inner inset from ragged alpha edges. Preload once and reuse.
